aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource delivers to s3_bucket aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, but no dependency (attribute or depends_on) links it to aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy, which grants bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com permission to write (s3:PutObject, s3:GetBucketPolicy, with aws:SourceArn conditions). AWS validates destination bucket access at export-creation time; if the export is created before the policy is attached, the apply can fail with an AccessDenied/validation error — or, per the upstream provider bug noted in the code comments, the export gets created in AWS while the apply fails, requiring a manual import. Add depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy] (no attribute on the export can reference the policy, so a bare depends_on is the idiomatic fix here).

module.cur_per_resource has an explicit depends_on on aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource, but the same ordering is already established by the attribute reference logging_log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource.name. The explicit depends_on duplicates an implicit dependency and should be removed.
